shape.purpose: Define the surface's job, intent, states and acceptance

system.purpose: Trace product and visual authority to existing sources

typeset.purpose: Make typography support reading and task priority

layout.purpose: Organize hierarchy, density and responsive composition

colorize.purpose: Use semantic color with verified contrast

bolder.purpose: Increase deliberate emphasis where the brief warrants it

quieter.purpose: Reduce visual competition without removing useful cues

distill.purpose: Remove unnecessary complexity while preserving the task

animate.purpose: Use purposeful motion and reduced-motion alternatives

delight.purpose: Add helpful feedback and product-specific personality

onboard.purpose: Design first use, empty states and return journeys

clarify.purpose: Improve action labels, recovery and evidence-backed copy

harden.purpose: Cover data, permission, localization and failure boundaries

adapt.purpose: Preserve the task across viewports and input methods

optimize.purpose: Measure interaction and rendering costs before changing them

extract.purpose: Extract repeated tokens and components with verified callers

critique.purpose: Record design judgment before detector findings

audit.purpose: Verify required behavior with contextualized detector evidence

polish.purpose: Close specific fidelity and state gaps in bounded passes

compare.purpose: Inspect comparable baseline and candidate captures

live.purpose: Run optional local visual iteration with explicit scope and recovery
